ley.label: Ley

hierarchy.note: Codes only (Código Civil, Código de Comercio, etc.). Format: 'LIBRO PRIMERO'. Not used in ordinary leyes.
Sección is a high-level grouping in Uruguayan codes, sitting above Título. Maps to AKN part as an intermediate container. Format: 'SECCIÓN I'. Confirmed in Código de Proceso Civil.
Present in codes and complex leyes. Format: 'TÍTULO I – DISPOSICIONES GENERALES'. Roman numerals standard.
Most common higher division in ordinary leyes. Format: 'CAPÍTULO I'. Roman numerals.
Fundamental citable unit. Numbered continuously throughout the ley. Format: 'Artículo 1°.' or 'Art. 1°.' Strip degree symbol for eId: art_1.

Unnumbered paragraph within artículo. Referenced by positional ordinal: 'inciso primero', 'inciso segundo'. No Bluebell keyword — pipeline must post-process bare paragraph blocks inside <article> into <alinea> elements sequentially.
Numbered list items within artículo or inciso. Format: '1°', '2°', '3°'. Cited as 'numeral 1°'. Strip degree symbol for eId.
Lettered sub-items under numerales or directly under incisos. Format: 'A)', 'B)', 'C)'. Uppercase letters are standard in Uruguayan legislation. Cited as 'literal A)'.

hcontainers.name: tituloPreliminar
hcontainers.description: Preliminary title in codes preceding the main Libro/Título hierarchy. Present in Código Civil and Código General del Proceso.

hcontainers.name: disposicionTransitoria
hcontainers.description: Transitory provisions, typically at the end of codes and complex leyes. May be numbered or lettered.

hcontainers.name: disposicionDerogatoria
hcontainers.description: Repeal provisions section, grouping articles that derogate prior legislation.

ley.note: Standard Uruguayan ley. Citation: 'Ley N° 19.889'. Promulgated by the President and published in the Diario Oficial (IMPO). Numbered continuously since independence (no year component in the number).

decreto_ley.label: Decreto-Ley
decreto_ley.note: Issued by the de facto government (Consejo de Estado / Junta de Gobierno) during the civilian-military dictatorship 1973–1985. Many remain in force. Politically neutral FRBR URIs using decreto-ley subtype. Flag for human policy review. Structurally identical to ordinary leyes.

decreto.label: Decreto del Poder Ejecutivo
decreto.note: Executive regulations promulgated by the Poder Ejecutivo (President + relevant Minister). Cited as 'Decreto N° 326/996' (number/year, two-digit year historically). Since 2000 full four-digit year is used. Numbered per year.

resolucion.label: Resolución
resolucion.note: Administrative resolutions from ministries, autonomous entities, or the executive. Short-form instruments, typically few articles. Published in Diario Oficial.

constitucion.label: Constitución de la República Oriental del Uruguay

hierarchy.note: The 1967 Constitution is divided into 17 Secciones (Sections). Format: 'SECCIÓN I – DE LA NACIÓN Y SU SOBERANÍA'. Maps to AKN part as the top-level structural container.
330 articles numbered continuously across all Secciones and Capítulos.

hcontainers.name: disposicionTransitoriaEspecial
hcontainers.description: Lettered transitional provisions appended to the Constitution after the permanent articles. Format: 'A)', 'B)', 'C)' through the alphabet and beyond.

constitucion.note: The 1967 Constitution is the current operative text, with reforms via plebiscite in 1989, 1994, 1996, and 2004. The Suprema Corte de Justicia (plenary) exercises exclusive constitutional review jurisdiction — Uruguay has no separate Constitutional Court. Work URI anchored to 1967 promulgation.

frbr.number_note: Strip thousands-separator periods from Uruguayan citation format. 'Ley N° 19.889' → 19889 in URI. 'Decreto N° 326/996' → year must be normalised to four digits (1996) in URI. Display layer re-adds separator.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted articles use Latin ordinal suffixes: Artículo 5° bis, Artículo 12 ter. Observed in amended codes.

amendments.phrasing: Sustitúyese el artículo [N°] de la Ley N° [XX.XXX] por el siguiente:
amendments.cross_reference_format: el artículo [N°] de la Ley N° [XX.XXX]
